All five options are AI-generated - do not consider the possibility that a human wrote it. Read the text carefully and identify which model most likely produced it, based on writing style, structure, and phrasing.

confidence: 1 = pure guess, 5 = certain.

--- TEXT ---
Maintaining a clean and organized home is often dismissed as a chore, but in reality, it is one of the most effective ways to streamline your daily routine and reclaim your peace of mind. When everything in your living space has a designated home, you no longer have to endure the frantic, frustrating searches for misplaced keys, essential documents, or matching shoes right before you need to leave the house. By eliminating the daily clutter, you eliminate the constant, minor delays that accumulate throughout the week, allowing your mornings to flow smoothly and giving you back precious minutes that would otherwise be wasted in a state of panic.

Beyond the practical benefit of saving time, a tidy living space acts as a silent buffer against the emotional toll of daily life by significantly reducing background stress. Our physical surroundings have a profound impact on our mental state, and a chaotic room filled with piles of laundry, dirty dishes, and scattered papers sends constant, subtle signals of unfinished business to our brains. This visual noise keeps our nervous systems in a state of low-grade alertness, making it difficult to truly relax. In contrast, returning to a clean, orderly home at the end of a long day provides an immediate sense of calm and sanctuary, allowing your mind to decompress without the nagging guilt of chores left undone.

This sense of mental clarity directly translates into your productivity, as a clutter-free environment makes it far easier to focus on work or study. When your desk is clear and your surroundings are neat, your brain is freed from the cognitive load of processing excess visual stimuli, allowing you to direct your full attention to the task at hand. You will find that you can dive into deep work more quickly, maintain your concentration for longer periods, and experience fewer distractions that derail your train of thought. Ultimately, investing a few minutes each day into keeping your space tidy is not about achieving perfection, but about creating an environment that supports your well-being, saves your energy, and empowers you to navigate daily life with ease and efficiency.
--- END ---
